about: Published values that research found attached to an organisation but that are not its route: another organisation's inbox or phone, a fax, or an inbox on a domain that does not exist. Each entry is reviewed and sourced. scripts/contacts/build_contact_profiles.py leaves the value out of that organisation's profile, so the welfare and government runs never take it and the company-master merge never adds it. A value already in the company master is corrected through skills/silverleaf-update-lead-list instead. Match is by database and organisation (the name resolves a changed organisation ID) and by the value, normalised.
